methods.label: Complete the square
methods.explanation: \(2x^2-8x=-1\), so \(2(x^2-4x)=-1\). Adding 4 inside the parentheses and adding \(2\times4=8\) to the right-hand side gives \(2(x-2)^2=7\). Therefore, \(m=2\) and \(n=7\).
methods.levelReason: This is Grade 9 completing the square, supported by equality properties and the earlier perfect-square identity.
